card.name: Abbreviated classical source citations
card.fires_on: Partway through abbreviated author or work titles in scholarly citations, such as Philostr., Diet. Cret., Paus., Ovid Met., and Sum. Theol. It fires in old-style footnotes of classical or theological texts.

modes.label: Classical author abbreviations
modes.description: Inside or at the period of a shortened ancient author or work name in a parenthetical citation.

modes.label: Medieval and modern reference titles
modes.description: Inside abbreviated titles of theological or scholarly reference works, followed by book and section numbers.

card.writes: It pushes the next piece toward a single consonant or consonant cluster such as r, l, gr, cl, which continues an abbreviated title.
card.plain: It marks the middle of a shortened author or book name in an old-style scholarly footnote.
